. On 29.05.2019, a Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court, while directing inspection of the premises,
at Door No.78, Thirumalai Thirupathi Nagar, Kallakurichi, has also directed the officer, who caused such inspection, to be present in Court.
3. Pursuant to the directions, inspection has been made on 14.05.2019, and a report has been filed.
Mr.A.W.Syed Musthafa Kamal, Commissioner, Kallakurichi Municipality, is also present.

4. A perusal of paragraph No.8 of the report filed by the Commissioner, Kallakurichi Municipality,
would show that, no manufacturing activity is done, in the abovesaid primeses, the said shop has been closed and the licence cancelled.
For brevity, paragraph No.8 of the report dated 17.06.2019,
filed by the Commissioner, Kallakurichi Municipality, is extracted hereunder:-
"8. I submit that the 10th respondent made an application dated 23.04.2019 praying to remove the seal without making any application as ordered by the Hon'ble Division Bench to seek license.
I beg to submit that I have issued notice to the 10th respondent on 7.5.2019 to make inspection as per the order of the Hon'ble Division Bench.

Accordingly on 14.5.2019, I have made http://www.judis.nic.in inspection of the premises in the presence of Town Planning Inspector, work inspector, sanitary inspector-in charge and revenue inspector-in charge and the 10th respondent and A.Kasivel vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 19 June, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84087904/
3 opened the premises for the said limited purpose and found the premises was in a very unhygienic, unclean condition and emanating bad odour.

entities.text: A.Kasivel vs The State Of Tamil Nadu

sentences.text: The 10th respondent requested to clean the premises and for which he sought 1 month time which was refused and granted only two weeks time for cleaning purpose and also for the purpose of plastering the damaged floor and to white wash the premises for making application for license within the period as directed by this Hon'ble Court.
It is to be noted that no business activity of manufacturing of sweets and karam was carried out by the 10th respondent during the aforesaid period.

On completion of the cleaning work, removal of hazardous waste like oil tins, waste oils from which bad odour was emanating, card board boxes, damaged vessels etc., other personnel items, also the painting and plastering works were carried and thus the shop was locked.
I bet to submit that I reiterate no manufacturing activity is being conduced in the said premises."
5. In view of the above, writ petition is dismissed.
No Costs.
Consequently, the connected writ miscellaneous petition is closed.
